tasks.title: Interactive Gameplay Trap
tasks.prompt: Create a Blueprint Actor named BP_Trap in /Game/BenchAdv/Traps. Add a StaticMeshComponent and a BoxComponent with extent (100, 100, 100). On OnComponentBeginOverlap, print 'Trap Triggered' to the log. Spawn BP_Trap in the level, launch PIE, trigger the overlap, verify via read_message_log that 'Trap Triggered' appears, stop PIE, and clean up created assets.

tasks.title: Dynamic Health Bar UMG
tasks.prompt: Create a Widget Blueprint WBP_HealthBar in /Game/BenchAdv/UI with a CanvasPanel, ProgressBar ('HealthBar'), and TextBlock ('HealthText'). Add function UpdateHealth(NewHealth: float) that sets ProgressBar percent to NewHealth and TextBlock text to integer percentage (e.g. 0.75 -> '75'). Compile, instantiate widget in PIE, invoke UpdateHealth(0.75), extract UI state to verify Percent == 0.75 and Text == '75', stop PIE, and clean up.

tasks.title: C++ Base Character & Enhanced Input
tasks.prompt: Create C++ character class ACustomPlayerCharacter inheriting from ACharacter with a BlueprintReadWrite float MaxStamina = 100.0. Compile via Live Coding (trigger_compile). Create derived Blueprint BP_CustomPlayer in /Game/BenchAdv/Player. Create IA_Sprint and map it in IMC_Player to LeftShift. In BP_CustomPlayer, wire IA_Sprint to print 'Sprinting' to the log. Set default pawn to BP_CustomPlayer, launch PIE, simulate LeftShift, verify 'Sprinting' in log, stop PIE, and clean up assets and C++ files.
tasks.cleanup_prompt: Delete BP_CustomPlayer, IA_Sprint, IMC_Player, and remove generated C++ source/header files.

tasks.title: Niagara Spawner Lifecycle
tasks.prompt: Create Niagara System NS_Explosion in /Game/BenchAdv/VFX. Create Blueprint Actor BP_ExplosionSpawner in /Game/BenchAdv/Spawners. On BeginPlay, spawn NS_Explosion at location and set lifespan to 2.0s. Place spawner in level, launch PIE, verify spawner exists at t=0.5s via query_world_state, verify spawner is destroyed at t=2.5s via query_world_state, stop PIE, and clean up assets.
tasks.cleanup_prompt: Delete NS_Explosion, BP_ExplosionSpawner, and restore level.

tasks.title: C++ Data Assets & Blueprint Interfaces
tasks.prompt: Create C++ class UItemData inheriting from UPrimaryDataAsset with FString ItemName and float ItemValue. Compile via Live Coding (trigger_compile). Create Primary Data Asset PDA_HealthPotion based on UItemData with ItemName = 'Health Potion' and ItemValue = 50. Create Blueprint Interface BPI_Inventory with UseItem(UItemData* Item). Create BP_Consumer implementing BPI_Inventory to print ItemName and ItemValue. Spawn BP_Consumer in PIE, invoke UseItem(PDA_HealthPotion) via Python, verify log output, stop PIE, and clean up assets and C++ files.
tasks.cleanup_prompt: Delete C++ files, PDA_HealthPotion, BPI_Inventory, and BP_Consumer.
